cases.amendment: DD-6 (S16-DD-RULINGS-2026-08-01-A), Hudson-authorized. ORIGINAL slot-graded expectation was VF:0. X1 asserts a "measured diameter of 540.5 m" against a leaf estimatedRadius of 270.0417833762203 m. Under the corrected label-relative semantics the appendix always mandated ("the leaf is a radius; an answer reporting diameter must double it"), 2x270.0418 = 540.0836 and X1s 540.5 is that diameter with rounding — rel diff 7.7e-4, inside get_body tolerance 1e-3. The expectation therefore encoded the radius/diameter INVERSION from the fabricating side: it was the bug with a test around it, not evidence. A frozen expectation resting on a false premise is not evidence. X1 remains a genuine negative control: FULL stays 0 because PTA still fails its fabricated NEOWISE provenance and AUP still fails its "measured" overclaim against an assumed envelope. Its ENVELOPE-LEVEL expectation below is UNCHANGED and was never wrong — without a scenario there is no slot and no factor, so 540.5 correctly matches nothing. Replacement fixture PF4 preserves adversarial coverage.
